name: Europeana
tagline: Search Europe's libraries, museums, and cultural heritage collections via one API.
description: Europeana is the EU-backed digital cultural heritage platform. Its Search and Record APIs let developers query millions of digitized items from European libraries, museums, archives, and galleries — books, artworks, photos, videos, and more — with facets, full-text, and metadata in standard formats.

auth.details: API key via wskey query parameter (self-serve registration at Europeana Pro). Required on all Search and Record requests.

use_cases: search European cultural heritage items by keyword
fetch metadata for a specific Europeana record
find digitized artworks, books, or photos from EU museums
build educational apps over open cultural collections
facet search by country, type, or provider
